On the farms there is lambing and calving to deal with, ground nesting birds are beginning to breed on the moors, and training has begun for the camogie season. But then The Glens, like the rest of Northern Ireland goes into lockdown, as the Covid-19 virus hits the UK. The programme shows how the natural spring beauty of The Glens provides a sanctuary for the inhabitants.

Elsewhere, Great Britain's 2024 world indoor champion Molly Caudery takes part in the pole vault, facing off against two-time world champion Katie Moon and Canadian record holder Alysha Newman.

programme.title: Life in the Air
programme.desc: With the help of some surprising creatures from around the world, we'll discover how animals take to the air, defying the force all airborne animals must conquer - gravity. In Africa a caracal cat's `rocket-propelled' launch enables it to catch birds in flight. In the Australian outback a kangaroo's hop is key to finding water in a desert over a million square kilometres.

programme.title: Interior Design Masters
programme.desc: The designers set off to the high street, doing up shops in Rye. Working in teams, they transform an Indian paper shop and a women's boutique before being critiqued by Mary Portas.

programme.title: Nadiya Bakes

programme.title: Anna Haugh's Big Irish Food Tour
programme.desc: Sligo, often called Ireland's hidden gem, is full of culinary delights. Actor Pauline McLynn shows Anna around as they are put to work on an oyster farm during the busy season.

programme.title: Nigel Slater's Simple Suppers
programme.desc: Nigel Slater shows that spicy food isn't all about hot chillis. Using a range of everyday spices, he creates a week's worth of tasty dishes that will appeal to everyone. Thai spiced aubergines, chilli feta and a quick korma are all simple dishes that combine warm and hearty spices, but don't burn your mouth. Nigel also visits Liverpool to visit allotment holders Rachel and Paul.

programme.title: Murder on the Orient Express
programme.desc: A financier travelling from Istanbul to Paris is found dead, stabbed a dozen times, and it is up to celebrated Belgian detective Hercule Poirot to solve the crime. He painstakingly interviews those in the same railway car and through an elaborate re-creation aims to find out just who carried out the deed.

programme.title: 27 Dresses
programme.desc: Perennial bridesmaid Jane always puts the needs of others before her own, making her the go-to gal whenever someone needs help with wedding plans. So when Jane's younger sister Tess snags the man Jane secretly loves, Jane finds herself questioning her role as a wedding junkie for the first time in her life. Meanwhile, a handsome reporter sees Jane's unusual story as his ticket off the bridal beat.

programme.title: Flog It!
programme.desc: Hundreds of locals arrive with their family heirlooms for the experts Christina Trevanion and Nick Davies to decide what should go off to auction. Christine is drawn to a pair of fancy shoes, and Nick finds a pair of Bohemian glass vases. Meanwhile, Paul Martin digs deep into the history of the life of a coal mine.

programme.desc: Steve leads a team into the largest unexplored cave network on Earth. Below the jungles of Mexico, they traverse narrow passageways and flooded tunnels in a quest to go further than anyone has gone before.

programme.desc: Monica and Rob travel to the highlands of central Sri Lanka to learn about Ceylon Tea Trails, a series of colonial era bungalows that have been renovated and reinvented by a local family of tea entrepreneurs.

programme.desc: Jeremy Clarkson, James May and Richard Hammond attempt to race from Northern Canada to the North Pole, 450 miles away. The terrain in between is some of the toughest on earth where temperatures can drop to a mind-numbing minus 65 degrees Celcius. Jeremy and James will be driving a specially adapted pick-up truck, whilst Richard will be travelling on a sled pulled by a team of dogs.

programme.title: Scandinavia with Simon Reeve

programme.title: Later ... with Jools Holland

programme.title: Yesterday
programme.desc: Jack Malik is a struggling singer-songwriter in an English seaside town whose dreams of fame are rapidly fading, despite the fierce devotion and support of his childhood best friend, Ellie. After a freak bus accident during a mysterious global blackout, Jack wakes up to discover that The Beatles have never existed. Performing songs by the greatest band in history to a world that has never heard them, Jack becomes on overnight sensation with a little help from his agent.

programme.title: Question Time
